openwrt_wiki.einleitung: introduced in spring 2016 ... delivered with OpenWrt 15.05 and Gl.iNet's proprietary user interface
features: USB A port for external storage with software power control.
Customised OpenWrt pre-installed from the factory (with GLI Web UI)
Configurable 2/3-position toggle switch (requires simple hardware mod for 3 position)
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: w25q128 16 MiB: u-boot 192 KiB, u-boot-env 64 KiB, factory 64 KiB, firmware 15872 KiB (kernel ~1.1 MiB, rootfs), art 64 KiB
openwrt_wiki.tftp: tftp upgrade requires connecting to the Serial port, and pressing spacebar during boot to access the U-Boot command line
openwrt_wiki.debricking: U-Boot web interface: LAN port, PC 192.168.1.2/24; router unplugged, press and hold reset, plug in, hold reset at least 3 seconds, release, http://192.168.1.1
openwrt_wiki.pakete_usb_mmc: kmod-rt2800-usb (?), kmod-sdhci-mt7620 (optional sdcard), kmod-usb-storage, block-mount, kmod-fs-vfat, kmod-fs-exfat
openwrt_wiki.oem_netz: br-lan 192.168.8.1/24, eth0.1 LAN, eth0.2 WAN (DHCP), wlan0 disabled
openwrt_wiki.switch_ports: Port 0 = WAN, Port 1 = LAN, Ports 2-5 nicht vorhanden, Port 6 = CPU
openwrt_wiki.buttons: Reset = reset; Schalter links/Mitte = BTN_1, rechts/Mitte = BTN_0; 3. Stellung (rechts) erst nach Gehäuse-Mod
openwrt_wiki.reset_oem: In the factory firmware, pressing the reset button briefly will toggle the wifi on/off. Holding the reset button for more than 5 seconds will result in a factory reset
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: Use a pry tool in the notch indicated. There are clips all round ... remove the PCB by lifting the edge furthest away from the LAN/WAN connector. Note the blue post on the cover that holds the PCB steady.
openwrt_wiki.microsd: Internal microSD cards can only be inserted after opening the case
openwrt_wiki.serial: The serial port on the GL-MT300A comes with the headers factory fitted. It can be seen at the top of the board between the external antenna connectors, with labels below "GND,RX,and TX". 115200, 8N1
openwrt_wiki.jtag: The GL-MT300A does not have JTAG support.
openwrt_wiki.schalter_gpio: GPIO 1 und 2; links: GPIO2 high; Mitte: beide low; rechts: GPIO1 high
openwrt_wiki.oem_bootlog: U-Boot 1.1.3 (Dec 23 2015 - 18:37:46), uboot-gl-mt7620 version 0.0.0.1, ASIC 7620_MP, DRAM 1024 Mbits DDR width 16, 128 MBytes, spi device id ef 40 18 -> W25Q128FV, CPU 580 MHz, 'Press WPS button for more than 2 seconds to run web failsafe mode', 'Hit SPACE to stop autoboot'; Kernel 3.18.27, 'Board has DDR2', 'SoC Type: MediaTek MT7620A ver:2 eco:6', CPU MIPS 24KEc, console=ttyS0,115200

gl_doku_v3.einleitung: MT300A is a mini router which has a MicroSD card slot inside. Its Wi-Fi performance and computation power is higher than MT300N.
gl_doku_v3.Interfaces: 1 WAN, 1LAN 1 USB2.0, 1 Micro USB (power), 1 Reset Button, TF Card Slot (128Gb Max. integrated on board)
gl_doku_v3.Webcam Support: MJPEG, YUV (not support from firmware v2.27)
gl_doku_v3.PCB Pinout: MT300A has headers for EMMC microSD card connector and 5V power pins.
gl_doku_v3.MicroSD Card Slot: GL-MT300A Router has a SD card slot inside. You need to open the case and insert the MicroSD card.

gl_doku_v2.Interfaces: 1 WAN, 1LAN 1 USB2.0, 1 Micro USB (power), 1 Reset Button, TF Card Slot (128GB Max. integrated on board)

gl_pinout.uFL Connector: CON1 und CON2, je 'uFL Connector (external antenna version)'
gl_pinout.3-state switch: SW1: GPIO1 High / GPIO1,2 Low / GPIO 2 High

features: UART and MicroSD interface, with MicroSD daughter board
